211220.description:
Adapted from a novel by Wen Zhou, this story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by demons who is sent by his master to leave Black-White Mountain and kill the three enemies responsible for the demons’ downfall. As he searches for the truth, he gradually unravels the mysteries behind the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and his own destiny.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

211496.description:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

211070.description:
Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say...

"Will you marry me?! "

(Source: Yen Press)

Eri is now a high school student with a dream of becoming a musician. Next week will be her first street performance, but when she turns to Deku, now a teacher at U.A., about it...

211308.description:
Princess Sapphire of the lost kingdom. Stripped of everything in her homeland, Silverland, by the calamity known as "Nergal," she arrived in Goldland at the very depths of despair. While carrying the weight of her past, she began to find a glimmer of hope through the kindness of the people. Yet, as if mocking her peaceful daily life, the calamity "Nergal" appears once more. The same despair that reduced her homeland to ashes is now threatening to steal the light from this land as well.

"No more loss for me. No more loss for anyone.”

Wiping way her fears of sorrow, the young girl takes up her sword.
This is the story of a hero who ties her ribbon and resolves to defy fate.

(Source: THE RIBBON HERO Official Site)

Note: This anime is inspired by Osamu Tezuka's manga "Princess Knight”.
synonyms: เดอะริบบิ้นฮีโร่

211877.description:
For the first time in my life, I have a girlfriend. But her friend tempts me with a body that's so seductive... What would you do if your girlfriend's friend came on to you like this?

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: 世界最強の魔女、始めました

211778.description:
When Rona manifests what seems to be a terribly useless skill, she’s considered an embarrassment to her family and gets kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she nears her darkest hour… when she suddenly figures out how to use her skill called “Internet.” It allows her to produce unlimited valuable items and even acquire rare equipment without participating in any events. With this skill of godlike knowledge, she can do anything she wants!

(Source: Yen Press)

211709.description:
The Quintessential Quintuplets: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter adapts the official sequel novel penned by Hajime Asano—a work that depicts "the continuation of the original story"—under the complete supervision of the original manga author, Negi Haruba.

Spanning the period from January of their third year of high school through December following their graduation, this series portrays a fresh year in the daily lives of the quintuplets.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: Title and relations are provisional and subject to change.

211710.description:
This project brings to life—in animated form for the very first time—episodes from the original manga that were never featured in the previous anime series.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: Title and relations are provisional and subject to change.

211557.description:
“I never imagined things would turn out like this…” Kai, who ended up spending an intimate night with a woman living in the apartment building next door, reflects on his actions. Taking advantage of the fact that a room in the neighboring building happened to be completely visible, he began spending his days soothing himself by watching Ikenaga—who was exposing her vulnerable self—through his lens. But one morning, he accidentally called out to her! From that moment on, a relationship with the woman he’d been spying on began to develop…?

(Source: Lune-soft, translated)

title.native: メガネ、時々、ヤンキーくん

211304.description:
Momose has always longed for a peaceful high school life. She wants nothing to do with hoodlums, delinquents, or troublemakers. When she meets Ichikura, an inconspicuous black-haired boy with glasses, he looks like a normal, nice guy. But it turns out that back in junior high he was a nefarious delinquent! He keeps assuring her that he’s changed his ways, but he still has a knack for picking fights! Has Ichikura really turned over a new leaf? And will Momose keep the secret about his rowdy past?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent

title.english: Glasses With a Chance of Delinquent

211338.description:
Based on the erotic game by Resta.

It's summer. You and your friends are on vacation, when suddenly the sea carries your boat away to an unknown island in another world. This island—Paradisiem Island—is small, with one village. According to the village chief, the island's Guardian Deity foresaw the arrival of you and your friends, and they want you to help the island return to its former glory. Without more tourists, there aren't enough people to worship the Guardian Deity, whose powers you need to return to your home world. Work together with your friends, Sahoto, Mei, and Chiyo, as well as some new friends you make on the island, to help it grow and prosper into a popular tourist destination!

(Source: Steam)

211538.description:
The story takes place in Iceland, at land’s end, 64°N.
Kei Miyama is a 17-year-old with three secrets: he can talk to cars, he can’t handle pretty girls, and he works as a private investigator. One case has him searching for a beloved dog, another involves reuniting a woman with a man she fell for at first sight. And then comes a case that strikes close to home—searching for his own little brother.
Tag along as this globe-spanning journey unfolds…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

211232.description:
A short film only screened at the Cinema Orion at Ghibli Park in Nagakute.

The film is set in Ghibli Park's "Valley of the Witches" and is the first original animated short film created by Studio Ghibli for Ghibli Park.
synonyms: Night in the Valley of Witches

211262.description:
Part of a series of animated short films shown at the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka called "Film Guru Guru".

A short film of a fire demon called "Bobo-kun," eating one piece of coal after another. This character would later be re-used as Calcifer, who appears in Howl's Moving Castle.

211260.description:
Part of a series of animated short films shown at the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka called "Film Guru Guru".

Yubaba, a character from Spirited Away, returns in this short. She turns to the front, opens her mouth and laughs, and when she turns 180 degrees and turns backward, a small bird comes out of her hair and screams. When the little bird retracts into her hair, Yubaba turns 180 degrees again, turns to the front, and laughs once more.

title.romaji: Arafou Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki
title.native: アラフォー賢者の異世界生活日記

211258.description:
Satoshi Oosako was a player of the VRRPG "Sword and Sorcery" who defeated the Evil God and died for his troubles. When he awoke again he found himself in a strange unknown forest. Furthermore he possessed his avatar's body and abilities. In other words, he was a cheat. Can a 40-year-old virgin live peacefully in this world?

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
synonyms: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World

211301.description:
Music video directed and animated by Kukka for the song Kaze no Anthem by Eve featuring vocals by suis (from Yorushika).

Note: The song featured in this music video was also used as the opening song in the anime Tongari Boushi no Atelier.

211331.description:
Graduation work of Shuzuku.

A girl wanders through a landscape of quiet ruin, alone except for her dog and a mysterious voice on her radio, reciting poems at a precise hour every day. A haunting memory of a nearby future.

(Source: Fantasia International Film Festival)

Notes:
- Selected and pre-screened at the Fantasia International Film Festival as a part of the Anime no Bento official selection on July 19, 2025.
- Won the Grand Prix at the Kochi Anime Creator Award 2025 out of 30 nominated works.

211328.description:
Young animator Mito feels trapped between the demands of a difficult sequence, a tight deadline, debilitating self-doubt, and a seemingly deranged director. Sometimes the only way to get to the other side is to charge right through.

(Source: Fantasia International Film Festival)

Note: Originally released on June 28, 2024 as a part of "Gemnibus Vol. 1" anthology, however was also simultaneously selected to screen, and then later premiered at Fantasia International Film Festival.

211217.description:
The world is an illusion, but love is real. At eighteen, Gao Yang accidentally discovers the cruel truth of the world: his family and friends are all terrifying "beasts," and these "beasts" will kill anyone who discovers the truth. Facing the "beasts'" frenzied attacks, Gao Yang, on the verge of death, activates a mysterious system and awakens his talent Luck, thus beginning a game of survival between lamb and wolf…

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

211219.description:
Following the fall of a red meteorite, humanity stopped making progress. In fact, they lost the ability to build rockets, nuclear weapons, airplanes, cars... At the same time, a kingdom from another world threatens to destroy human civilization.
A mysterious figure then steps forward to save humanity...

(Source: iQIYI, translated)
